apis.name: NtDelayExecution
apis.summary: The NtDelayExecution routine delays the calling thread until a deadline or an allowed interruption.
apis.description: The NtDelayExecution routine delays the calling thread until a deadline or an allowed interruption. This is a scheduling delay, not a wait for an object's signal and not a precision clock. Expiration makes execution eligible, not necessarily immediate; other scheduling work can delay return. A yield does not prove another thread ran or completed useful work, and is not a replacement for synchronization. Do not treat STATUS_NO_YIELD_PERFORMED as failure or as a count of ready threads.

parameters.description: Required readable LARGE_INTEGER; NULL does not mean an infinite delay. Units are 100 nanoseconds: negative values are relative intervals, positive values are absolute times since January 1, 1601 (UTC), and zero requests a scheduling yield. User input must be 4-byte aligned on x64 and its WoW64 forwarding path. The captured input is not updated with remaining time.

apis.name: NtDeleteKey
apis.summary: Deletes an opened registry key, not merely a value and not a recursive subtree.
apis.description: Deletes an opened registry key, not merely a value and not a recursive subtree. Remove subkeys from the leaves upward before deleting their parent. Existing handles do not become usable handles to a replacement key: subsequent basic queries on them return STATUS_KEY_DELETED, yet NtClose remains required. apis.summary: The NtMapViewOfSection routine maps a view of a section into the virtual address space of a subject process.
apis.description: The NtMapViewOfSection routine maps a view of a section into the virtual address space of a subject process. Use to establish a view of a section in a process. Two writable views of one paging-file-backed section share the same storage; each view must be unmapped separately, independently of closing section handles.

parameters.description: A handle to an existing section object.

parameters.name: ProcessHandle
parameters.description: A handle to the object that represents the process that the view should be mapped into. The handle must have been opened with PROCESS_VM_OPERATION access.

parameters.name: BaseAddress
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the base address of the view. If the value is not NULL, the view is allocated starting at the specified virtual address rounded down to the next 64-kilobyte address boundary.

parameters.name: ZeroBits
parameters.description: The number of high-order address bits that must be zero in the base address of the section view. The value of this parameter must be less than 21 and is used only if BaseAddress is NULL.

parameters.name: CommitSize
parameters.description: Specifies the size, in bytes, of the initially committed region of the view. CommitSize is meaningful only for page-file backed sections and is rounded up to the nearest multiple of PAGE_SIZE.

parameters.name: SectionOffset
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the offset, in bytes, from the beginning of the section to the view.

parameters.name: ViewSize
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that specifies the size of the view in bytes. If the initial value is zero, NtMapViewOfSection maps a view of the section that starts at SectionOffset and continues to the end of the section.

parameters.name: InheritDisposition
parameters.description: A value that specifies how the view is to be shared with child processes.

parameters.name: AllocationType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of allocation to be performed for the specified region of pages. Although MEM_COMMIT is not allowed, it is implied unless MEM_RESERVE is specified.

apis.description: RtlNtStatusToDosError translates an NTSTATUS code into a Win32 error code. The mapping is not always one-to-one: several native statuses can collapse to the same Win32 error. The function returns ERROR_MR_MID_NOT_FOUND when no mapping exists.
apis.prototype: ULONG RtlNtStatusToDosError(NTSTATUS Status);

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The native status value to translate.

return.success: Returns the corresponding Win32 error code, or ERROR_MR_MID_NOT_FOUND when no mapping exists.
return.failure: No failure status is returned; inspect the returned Win32 error value.

apis.remarks: Use this routine when an NTSTATUS must be surfaced through a Win32 error path. Do not assume the mapping is reversible. For diagnostics, keep the original NTSTATUS as well.

apis.name: RtlInitUnicodeString
apis.summary: Initializes a UNICODE_STRING to describe an existing wide-character string.
apis.description: RtlInitUnicodeString sets the Length, MaximumLength, and Buffer fields of a UNICODE_STRING to reference an existing null-terminated wide string. It does not copy or allocate the string. The source must remain valid for as long as the UNICODE_STRING is used.
apis.prototype: VOID RtlInitUnicodeString(PUNICODE_STRING DestinationString, PCWSTR SourceString);

parameters.name: DestinationString
parameters.description: Structure that receives the length and a pointer to SourceString.

parameters.name: SourceString
parameters.description: Optional null-terminated wide string. NULL produces an empty string descriptor.

return.success: This routine returns no status and initializes the descriptor on success.
return.failure: None; an invalid destination pointer is a caller bug.

apis.remarks: No memory is allocated, so do not free the Buffer field. Length is set to the byte length without the terminator, and MaximumLength includes the terminator. Keep SourceString alive while the descriptor is in use.

apis.name: RtlAllocateHeap
apis.summary: Allocates a block from a specified RTL heap.
apis.description: RtlAllocateHeap allocates memory from a heap created or obtained by the caller, such as the process heap from GetProcessHeap. Flags select zero-initialization, no-serialization, and other heap behaviors. The returned block must be released with RtlFreeHeap on the same heap.
apis.prototype: PVOID RtlAllocateHeap(HANDLE HeapHandle, ULONG Flags, SIZE_T Size);

parameters.name: HeapHandle
parameters.description: Handle to the heap from which to allocate.

parameters.name: Flags
parameters.description: Heap flags such as HEAP_ZERO_MEMORY or HEAP_NO_SERIALIZE.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Number of bytes to allocate.

return.success: Returns a pointer to the allocated block on success.
return.failure: Returns NULL on failure; call GetLastError for a Win32 error code.

apis.remarks: Use the same heap handle when freeing the block. HEAP_NO_SERIALIZE is only safe when the caller provides external synchronization. Zero-size allocations are implementation-defined.

apis.name: RtlFreeHeap
apis.summary: Frees a block allocated from an RTL heap.
apis.description: RtlFreeHeap releases a block previously allocated by RtlAllocateHeap or another routine on the same heap. The heap handle and flags must be compatible with the allocation. Freeing an invalid or already-freed pointer corrupts the heap.
apis.prototype: BOOLEAN RtlFreeHeap(HANDLE HeapHandle, ULONG Flags, PVOID BaseAddress);

parameters.name: HeapHandle
parameters.description: Handle to the heap that owns the block.

parameters.name: Flags
parameters.description: Free flags, typically zero or HEAP_NO_SERIALIZE when that mode was used consistently.

parameters.name: BaseAddress
parameters.description: Pointer to the block to free. NULL is allowed and is a no-op.

return.success: Returns TRUE when the block was freed.
return.failure: Returns FALSE when the block could not be freed.

apis.remarks: Do not mix blocks from different heaps. Freeing memory that is still referenced creates a use-after-free. Debug builds can enable heap validation to catch double frees.

apis.name: RtlCaptureStackBackTrace
apis.summary: Captures a stack back trace for the calling thread.
apis.description: RtlCaptureStackBackTrace walks the current call stack and returns up to the requested number of return addresses. It can also compute a hash of the captured frames. The function captures the current thread's user-mode stack and is commonly used for lightweight diagnostics.
apis.prototype: USHORT RtlCaptureStackBackTrace(ULONG FramesToSkip, ULONG FramesToCapture, PVOID *BackTrace, PULONG BackTraceHash);

parameters.name: FramesToSkip
parameters.description: Number of leading frames to omit from the result.

parameters.name: FramesToCapture
parameters.description: Maximum number of return addresses to store.

parameters.name: BackTrace
parameters.description: Array that receives the return addresses.

parameters.name: BackTraceHash
parameters.description: Optional pointer that receives a hash of the captured frames.

return.success: Returns the number of frames captured.
return.failure: Returns zero when no frames could be captured; the routine does not return an NTSTATUS.

apis.remarks: The addresses are only meaningful while the corresponding modules remain loaded. Symbol resolution requires matching PDBs and module bases. The hash is useful for grouping identical stacks but is not cryptographic.

apis.name: LdrGetProcedureAddress
apis.summary: Resolves an exported function or variable in a loaded module.
apis.description: LdrGetProcedureAddress looks up an export by name or ordinal in a loaded module and returns its address. It is the loader-level operation beneath GetProcAddress. The module must remain loaded while the returned address is used.
apis.prototype: NTSTATUS LdrGetProcedureAddress(PVOID DllHandle, PCANSI_STRING ProcedureName, ULONG ProcedureNumber, PVOID *ProcedureAddress);

parameters.name: DllHandle
parameters.description: Loader module base of the loaded DLL.

parameters.name: ProcedureName
parameters.description: Optional ANSI_STRING containing the export name.

parameters.name: ProcedureNumber
parameters.description: Optional export ordinal. Ignored when ProcedureName is provided.

parameters.name: ProcedureAddress
parameters.description: Pointer that receives the resolved address.

return.success: Returns STATUS_SUCCESS on success. Other NTSTATUS values describe the failure.
return.failure: A non-success NTSTATUS value. Use RtlNtStatusToDosError or the documented status codes to interpret it.

apis.remarks: Provide either a name or an ordinal, not both. The returned address is only valid while the module stays loaded. Forwarded exports can resolve into a different module.

apis.name: LdrUnloadDll
apis.summary: Unloads a DLL from the calling process.
apis.description: LdrUnloadDll releases a load reference for a DLL and unloads it when the reference count reaches zero. It performs the loader-side work beneath FreeLibrary, including calling DLL detach routines. Do not unload a module while code or data from it is still in use.
apis.prototype: NTSTATUS LdrUnloadDll(PVOID DllHandle);

parameters.name: DllHandle
parameters.description: Loader module base returned by LdrLoadDll, LoadLibrary, or LdrGetDllHandle when a reference was acquired.

return.success: Returns STATUS_SUCCESS on success. Other NTSTATUS values describe the failure.
return.failure: A non-success NTSTATUS value. Use RtlNtStatusToDosError or the documented status codes to interpret it.

apis.remarks: The module base is not an object-manager handle and must not be passed to NtClose. A lookup through LdrGetDllHandle does not add a reference, so it should not be balanced with LdrUnloadDll. Unloading runs DLL detach callbacks.

apis.name: LdrGetDllHandle
apis.summary: Retrieves the loader handle of an already loaded module.
apis.description: LdrGetDllHandle looks up a module that is already loaded in the process and returns its loader base. The lookup does not add a load reference. The optional DllPath and characteristics parameters constrain the search.
apis.prototype: NTSTATUS LdrGetDllHandle(PCWSTR DllPath, PULONG DllCharacteristics, PCUNICODE_STRING DllName, PVOID *DllHandle);

parameters.name: DllPath
parameters.description: Optional search path or LDR_PATH_* flags. NULL uses the default search order.

parameters.name: DllCharacteristics
parameters.description: Optional pointer to DLL characteristics used during the lookup.

parameters.name: DllName
parameters.description: Name of the loaded module to find.

parameters.name: DllHandle
parameters.description: Pointer that receives the module base on success.

return.success: Returns STATUS_SUCCESS on success. Other NTSTATUS values describe the failure.
return.failure: A non-success NTSTATUS value. Use RtlNtStatusToDosError or the documented status codes to interpret it.

apis.remarks: A successful lookup does not increase the module reference count. Do not call LdrUnloadDll to balance it unless a separate reference was acquired. Initialize the output only after NT_SUCCESS.

apis.name: LdrFindEntryForAddress
apis.summary: Finds the loader data table entry containing an address.
apis.description: LdrFindEntryForAddress searches the loaded-module list for the module that contains a given address and returns a borrowed pointer to its LDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY. The address may be a module base or any address inside the module, including an exported function.
apis.prototype: NTSTATUS LdrFindEntryForAddress(PVOID DllHandle, PLDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY *Entry);

parameters.name: DllHandle
parameters.description: Address inside a loaded module, such as the module base or a function address.

parameters.name: Entry
parameters.description: Receives a borrowed pointer to the matching loader data table entry.

return.success: Returns STATUS_SUCCESS on success. Other NTSTATUS values describe the failure.
return.failure: A non-success NTSTATUS value. Use RtlNtStatusToDosError or the documented status codes to interpret it.

apis.remarks: The returned entry is borrowed internal loader state and is not safe across concurrent unloads. Do not free it. Copy the fields you need while the module remains loaded.
